reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.source_ceiling: Own analytical application of received full native/current meanings, newly read original D28/D39, and one constructed NX08 execution. No new external source, verified toolchain, production rollout or empirical effectiveness claim.
common.authority_boundary: Successful compatibility evidence does not authorize migration, mutation or worker retirement. The constructed eligibility relation is not real routing enforcement.
common.cost: Pinning retains old workers/dependencies/storage; migration adds transformation and validation work; cutover can incur accepted downtime; all methods retain interpretation and affected-change costs. No empirical cost figures or universally optimal policy are asserted.
common.reentry: Changed observations, units, identity semantics, overflow, allowed pairings, replay status, downstream stages or routing/retention assumptions reopen only the affected argument. Display-label bytes can change without changing this observation relation.
common.type_model_detail: Typing is the explicit representation predicate H_v=List(String×Integer) with v∈{1,2}. A copy maps H_1 to H_2 and therefore preserves that representation predicate for all finite lists. It need not preserve Obs_v(h)=[(intent,n/divisor(v))]. This one-line mathematical preservation argument is separate from the Python parsing evaluations and proves no Python language meta-theorem.

receiving_native_role.shared_object: The eligible execution/migration path for each live workflow history, including ordered intent and quantity semantics.
receiving_native_role.partial_role: A migration-validity premise for a named history; it need not establish every worker/history pairing or any external effect.
receiving_native_role.criterion: A history retains a compatible pinned worker or a migration preserving its required command observations. In NX08 W1 serves v1 and W2 serves v2; all four pairings are not required.
receiving_native_role.residual: Actual routing, worker lifetime, retained dependencies, replay status, crash durability, external-effect identity, deployment and authority remain separate.

rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The relation equates the ordered intent IDs and exact rational quantities of the old and migrated history. Multiplication by10 establishes that relation in the stipulated semantics; merely copying integer fields does not. This supplies a concrete representation-preservation premise.
rows.guard: Use source interpretation n/100 and target m/1000, stable sequence/intent, exact unbounded arithmetic, and precisely these observations. Transfer only predicates invariant under this relation. A refinement label does not cover timing, unknown effects or later unvalidated stages.
rows.contrary_control: NX08 raw copying passes the representation check but changes100/100 to100/1000. Changing an intent ID also fails the selected relation. The relation deliberately ignores a display label only because this named consumer does.
rows.nontrigger_or_cheaper_alternative: Keep compatible old workers, finish histories before cutover, or directly compare the small required observations; a general refinement toolchain is not mandatory.

receiving_native_role.residual: Actual routing, worker lifetime, retained dependencies, replay status, crash durability, external-effect identity, deployment and authority remain separate.

rows.source_contribution_and_receiving_change: The D criterion identifies the missing value relation and intent/order semantics that ordinary representation typing does not express. It thereby limits the actual application credit of a type result, while retaining valid representation safety.
rows.guard: A richer unit/refinement type may express the necessary relation and would need its own proof and faithful interpretation. D28/D39 do not imply a typing theorem or prohibit such richer types.
rows.contrary_control: Both correct scaling and wrong copying retain integer fields. The counterexample does not refute the typing fact; it refutes extending that fact to an unstated functional relation.
rows.nontrigger_or_cheaper_alternative: Keep ordinary representation checks and add the direct semantic equality check only where required. Encoding the entire migration policy in dependent types is not automatically cheaper.
